laws.description: Inspector organizes chord analysis into exactly seven progressive tabs.
Piano keyboard maps accurately across 88 physical keys (21..108 MIDI).
Switching from Manual to Auto voicing requires user confirmation to prevent accidental loss.
Adding an exact MIDI unison duplicate in manual mode is rejected; octave doublings are permitted.
All annotation text is strictly sanitized to prevent HTML/script injection and bounded to 500 code points.
Chord preview sounds via real audio channels without side effects on playhead, selection, or document.
